audio_quality_note: Mobile handover at approximately 03:20 followed by sustained packet loss and speaker bleed. Diariser reports low separation confidence from turn 9 onward. Treat missing wording as unknown, not absent.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Daniel from Retailer One speaking. Before we go any further I need to let you know that this call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. Do I have your consent to continue on a recorded line?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, that's okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Can I confirm I'm speaking with the account holder, Mario Rossi, and that you're authorised to make changes to this account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Mario speaking. It's my account, my name's on the bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks Mario. And the supply address, 231 Sydney Road, Brunswick, three zero five six?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's right. Sorry, I'm walking to the car, is the reception alright your end?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're breaking up a little but I can hear you. Let me know if I drop out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Righto.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So this is about the Saver Flex plan. Before I go through any pricing there's a statement I have to read to you in full.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [crosstalk] go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The Default [inaudible] Offer is the [crosstalk] set by the Australian Energy [inaudible], and the estimated annual cost of this plan is—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sorry mate, you've gone all choppy. Say again?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: [inaudible] per cent less than the— for an average household in your— sorry, the line's terrible. [crosstalk]

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [crosstalk] hear about one word in three.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me try from the landline side. Can you hear me any better now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Bit better, yeah.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good. So, the plan. There's no lock-in and no exit fee, you can leave whenever you like.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And what's it going to cost me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So your peak usage rate is thirty— [crosstalk] cents per kilowatt hour, and the daily supply charge is [inaudible] cents a day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [crosstalk] than what I'm on now anyway.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It should be, yes. And the feed-in is four point five cents if you ever put solar on.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No solar. Renting.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No solar, noted. I'll send you the Basic Plan Information Document by email and you get ten business days cooling-off from when it arrives.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Two things I have to ask. Does anyone at the property rely on life support equipment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And do you hold a concession card? Pensioner, health care or DVA.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, health care card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll flag that so the concession carries across. You may need to re-verify it with us once the account is live, they usually send a text about it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. Hang on, I'm just getting in the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No rush, take your time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Right, I'm back. Sorry about that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: All good. So are you happy for me to go ahead and set this up on the Saver Flex plan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you Mario. I'll take that as your consent to transfer the electricity account at 231 Sydney Road to Retailer One on the Saver Flex plan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yep, that's right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Now the email for your welcome pack and contract. What's the best address for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's m dot rossi at [inaudible] dot com.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry Mario, at which one? You cut out on the provider.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [crosstalk] dot com, yeah.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I think I've got it. I'll send a confirmation text as well in case the email bounces.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No worries.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And the NMI off your bill, I've got 6 1 0 4 1 [inaudible] 2 3 3 4. Can you confirm that against the front page?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [crosstalk] haven't got the bill in front of me, I'm driving.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fine, I'll verify it from the distributor record on my side instead. Don't worry about it now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And this is electricity only, no gas at this stage?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Electricity only, yes. There's no gas at the place.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Electricity only, noted. That's everything from me. You'll get the welcome pack by email within one business day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [crosstalk]

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry, I missed that. Was there anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's it. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for your time Mario, drive safe.
